_comment: The platform profile's cron store is intentionally empty. The Hermes
directory holds jobs.json, executions.db and a .jobs.lock, but none of the
which exist only under the Chat Agent's HERMES_HOME/cron/. A job left here
is therefore inert — it sits in a roster nothing reads, which is how six
governance watchdogs went a release without firing.
Those six now live in agents/chat/defaults/cron/jobs.json as `no_agent`
entries that route to scripts/platform_cron_dispatch.py, which files the
kanban card into THIS profile. Do not add platform cron jobs here; add them
Hermes ignores every top-level key but `jobs` when it loads the store, so
